### Bug Fixes

### Features

* **YouTube & YouTube Music - Return YouTube Dislike:** Add `Show estimated likes` setting ([00793d8](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/commit/00793d87e1082d0adbf40f38d5cbd7057c68d6c7))
